# The British Museum

## Welcome to the British Museum

Experience cultures across the globe, from the dawn of human history to the present. 

[Plan your visit](https://www.britishmuseum.org/visit)

## Discover two million years of human history and culture

Free entry – [book online (Opens in new window)](https://ticketing.britishmuseum.org/events?k=general%20admission)

Open today: 10.00–17.00

Last entry: 16.45

## Visit the Museum

- ### [Plan your visit](https://www.britishmuseum.org/visit)

 Book tickets and plan your day including exhibitions, facilities, access, food and travel.

- ### [Museum map](https://www.britishmuseum.org/visit/museum-map)

 Navigate the Museum with ease, using our floor-by-floor plan and discover what not to miss.

- ### [Galleries](https://www.britishmuseum.org/collection/galleries)

 Walk through two million years of history and culture across more than 50 galleries.

- ### [Family visits](https://www.britishmuseum.org/visit/family-visits)

 From family facilities to activities and events, discover how to make the most of your day at the Museum.

## Become a Member

Enjoy exclusive events, access to exhibitions and the Members' Room, plus discounts in the Museum shops, cafés and restaurants.

[Find out more](https://www.britishmuseum.org/membership)

## What's online...

- ### [View the Bayeux Tapestry online](https://www.britishmuseum.org/bayeux-tapestry-online-experience)

 Follow the story, people, places and events that led to 1066 and the Battle of Hastings. Made for young learners, open to all.

- ### [Solving the mystery of a 2,000-year-old griffin (Opens in new window)](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DbFmmmGjp-n/?hl=en)

 Found inside buried ancient ruins, find out why no one could agree on the origins of this winged beast and how it was finally resolved.

- ### [What's missing from the Bayeux Tapestry? (Opens in new window)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1LUxfgWTv4M)

 Every story is shaped by someone. Discover what's been left out of the Tapestry – and how sometimes what we don't see can tell us the most.

- ### [Shining a light on Diwali (Opens in new window)](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DPwU52qEqTm/?hl=en-gb)

 Hear family stories and learn about traditions celebrating the festival of light, such as rangoli, passed down through generations.

## Sign up to our newsletters

Stay connected to the British Museum for the latest news, stories, exhibitions, events and visitor information.

[Sign up (Opens in new window)](https://emails.britishmuseum.org/k/British-Museum/sign_up_form_from_website_box)

## UK and the world

- ### [Research](https://www.britishmuseum.org/research)

 Driving the care, display and understanding of the collection, find out about projects, studentships and publications.

- ### [Departments](https://www.britishmuseum.org/our-work/departments)

 Learn about our research departments, outreach, training, study rooms and access to the collection.

- ### [National](https://www.britishmuseum.org/our-work/national)

 Find out how the Museum shares expertise and the collection across more than 250 UK cultural organisations.

- ### [International](https://www.britishmuseum.org/our-work/international)

 Loans, research and touring exhibitions are some of the many ways we build ties internationally. See our current collaborations.

## Search Collection online

From the Rosetta Stone to Japanese netsuke, discover a wealth of information about Museum objects in our searchable database.

[Start your search](https://www.britishmuseum.org/collection)
